name: campusflow
description: CampusFlow — campus mobility analytics and trajectory mining platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w client && npm run test:analytics
scripts.setup:analytics: python3 -m venv analytics/.venv && analytics/.venv/bin/pip install -r analytics/requirements.txt
